RaceMenu Mirrorwright - a character editor drawn over RaceMenu
Version 1.0.0

RaceMenu stays underneath and does all the real work. RaceMenu Mirrorwright draws its own editor over the RaceSex Menu through the
Apocrypha Menu Framework (or SKSE Menu Framework 3). F4 switches between the editor and RaceMenu's own interface.

Requirements: SKSE64, Address Library for SKSE Plugins, RaceMenu, Apocrypha Menu Framework (or SKSE Menu Framework 3).
Settings: Data\SKSE\Plugins\RaceMenuMirrorwright.ini, and the framework's RaceMenu Mirrorwright > Settings page.
Log for bug reports: Documents\My Games\Skyrim Special Edition\SKSE\RaceMenuMirrorwright.log (raise uLogLevel to 0 first).
